mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_coupon ( username, coupon_id, travel_id, issued_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{couponId}, #{travelId}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT cm.coupon_name AS couponName, cm.discount_type AS discountType, cm.discount_value AS discountValue, tc.travel_id AS travelId, tc.issued_at AS issuedAt, tc.used_yn AS usedYn
FROM travel_coupon tc
JOIN coupon_master cm ON tc.coupon_id = cm.coupon_id
WHERE tc.username = #{username}
ORDER BY tc.issued_at DESC
SELECT cm.coupon_name AS couponName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM travel_coupon tc JOIN coupon_master cm ON tc.coupon_id = cm.coupon_id GROUP BY cm.coupon_name ORDER BY count DESC
